title: Shared factory
description: Create a shared factory and reusable page chrome, then render a resource page.

children: Start with one shared factory for a product area. This keeps resource names, validation, UI primitives, and component naming consistent as pages grow. The examples use ArkType, matching the reference application's approach. Synchronous Standard Schema libraries such as Zod and Valibot also work.
